buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE 25% : The buyer can increase or decrease the contract quantity or contract duration up to 25 percent at the time of issue of the contract. However, once the contract is issued, the contract quantity or contract duration can only be increased up to 25 percent. Bidders are bound to accept the revised quantity or duration. For lumpsum-based service contracts, the buyer may increase the scope of work and contract value up to 25 percent with the consent of the service provider 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses -The skilled/unskilled workers or operatives provided by the Contractor shall not be considered employees of the Institution, nor shall they have any rights or claims as employees of the Institution. -The Institution shall not be held liable for the wages, allowances, bonuses, gratuity, leave pay, or any othe r such payments due to the skilled/unskilled workers or operatives provided by the Contractor. -It is mandatory for the Contractor to have an office registered within the state of Maharashtra. Furthermor e, preference will be given to a Contractor whose registration and office documents specify the nature of w ork relevant to the tender, and whose office is located within the Ratnagiri district. -Preference will also be given to Contractors who possess prior experience in providing similar services to establishments under the Government of Maharashtra. -The tender for this work is invited for a period of one year; therefore, the quoted rates shall remain valid f or at least one year. -The Principal reserves the right to extend the contract for a second year. The successful bidder (Contracto r) shall be required to deposit an amount equivalent to 5% of the total annual contract value with the College as a security deposit. -The said amount shall be refunded upon the termination of the agreement. No interest of any kind shall b e payable on the said amount. Workers may be transferred to other departments within the institution. -All workers are required to be present for duty at the institution from 9:15 AM to 6:15 PM. Furthermore, co nsidering the operational requirements of the college, workers may be required to stay beyond the stipulat ed office hours or attend on holidays; no additional remuneration shall be provided for such instances. -Apart from weekly offs and government-declared holidays, no other leave shall be admissible to the work ers. It shall be the sole responsibility of the worker to complete the assigned tasks within the prescribed ti meframe. The services rendered by the worker will be reviewed by the concerned Head of Department or t he Dean of the institution. - Before proceeding on leave, any worker provided by you must obtain permission from the relevant autho rity at the institution; in such cases, it is mandatory for the contractor to provide a substitute. In the event of a worker remaining absent continuously without any valid reason, you must immediately provide a subs titute to ensure that the institution's operations are not hindered. -Workers provided by you must adhere to professional decorum and the office code of conduct while worki ng at the institution. Assigned tasks must be performed diligently. If it is observed that a worker is not adh ering to the prescribed discipline, it shall be your responsibility—in the interest of the organization—to im mediately terminate the engagement of such a worker and provide a suitable replacement. -Given that this is an educational institution, it is mandatory to ensure that no employee engages in misco nduct; any such occurrence will lead to legal action. - Workers appointed by the contractor must work exclusively for this organization; they shall not be deploy ed in any other institution. Furthermore, you must ensure that these workers do not disclose any confident ial or sensitive information—pertaining to the organization or its offices—to any external parties. - Deliberate delays in work, encouraging others to do the same, late arrivals, failure to follow instructions, persistent absenteeism, reporting to work under the influence of alcohol, or any form of misconduct will be treated as unacceptable behavior. The organization will not tolerate such actions, and the services of any worker involved in such conduct will be terminated immediately. - A statement detailing the educational qualifications required for skilled/unskilled workers is attached (An nexure - E). Skilled/unskilled workers must be recruited in accordance with these specifications. Verificatio n documents for the employees must be submitted to the police authorities of the district where the respe ctive workers reside. -When providing skilled workers, the contractor must present the available personnel to the organization's management to verify their skill levels. The contractor shall supply only those skilled workers who have be en approved by the management. - The contractor shall be solely responsible for any accident, injury, or death involving the supplied worker s, whether occurring inside or outside the organization's premises. The organization shall not be held liable

under any circumstances. - It is the contractor's responsibility to ensure compliance with all labor laws (e.g., prohibition of child labor, regular medical check-ups for employees, payment of minimum wages, PF, insurance, the Minimum Wages Act 1948, etc.). The organization shall not be held responsible for any failure to comply with these require ments; the contractor shall be personally liable for any resulting legal or judicial proceedings. - The contractor must personally ensure that all safety regulations and protocols are strictly followed regar ding the skilled/unskilled workers or operators provided. - Employees provided by the contractor must wear the appropriate uniform and carry their identification ca rds at all times. - If the work in any specific department is found to be unsatisfactory on any given day, the average daily wage for that day shall be deducted from the payment due to the contractor. - It shall be mandatory to compile a daily report of work performed, signed by an authorized employee of t he respective department, and submit it to the office—duly signed by the authorized officer—along with th e monthly bill. The contractor’s payment shall be processed only after the submission of the monthly repor ts for the contract workers in the prescribed format. - The contractor must maintain up-to-date information and records regarding the workers provided to the i nstitution. Furthermore, such information and records must be made available for inspection whenever re quired by the institution. - The workers appointed by you will be assigned various tasks across different departments. It shall be ma ndatory for the concerned workers to complete the tasks assigned to them—by the respective Department Heads, Deans, Managers, or the faculty in-charge of the specific laboratory/department—within the stipulat ed timeframe. Additionally, it is mandatory to comply with any instructions issued from time to time by the Principal, Manager, or Department Heads of the institution. . 3.
